items.title: Zutty Singleton and Marge Singleton Interview, 1969-02-08
items.q: I played Maryville, sitting in on the piano that night with King.

ctx.x: Oh, sure. Oh, yeah. You still be hitting you, huh? After the mud knocked me out of half it. And my little officer, I'd love to see you in the bar called 25. Yeah. I was originally old Bloss. I was sick of me in the middle of the hill of the hill of the hill of the hill of the hill of the hill. I was crazy. I played Maryville, sitting in on the piano that night with King.…
